scope.allowed_now: Offline analysis/design of frozen local evidence; no remote code execution or publication
scope.launch_permission: Must be verified by the authorized server executor; this file grants no authority
scope.resources: Existing authorized allocation only; no newly purchased resources or physical-control writes

recommendation: Q quality/completion baseline, O observer-overhead diagnosis, then conditional R native eager-versus-graph runtime comparison

quality.strict_quality_matched_claim: All scheduled tasks in the predeclared finite set must complete and satisfy their predeclared quality contract in both arms
quality.heldout_policy: Q uses development/calibration only. Six heldout tasks are first run in R after candidate/protocol freeze, in baseline and candidate arms together. If accidentally exposed earlier, mark seen and remove blinded-generalization language, never secretly replace.

source_field_mapping.prompt_sha256: derived SHA256 of exact UTF-8 prompt bytes
source_field_mapping.quality_contract: prompt plus domain validator and recorded limits

quality.writing_completion: MACHINE_GATE_PASS_HUMAN_PENDING is not full quality PASS; predeclared content/genre review blinded to arm is required
quality.code_completion: Bounded interpreter-supported subset only; unsupported is UNKNOWN, never automatic failure or pass
quality.math_completion: Exact answer and stated inverse/counting equality only; not chain-of-thought reasoning certification
never_send_to_model: check oracle beyond template already in prompt

phase_mapping.O: calibration prompt export; observation mode/order added by server runner
phase_mapping.R0: calibration prompt export; paired feasibility assignment added by server runner
phase_mapping.R: R_paired, heldout, actual reviewed protocol/candidate freeze id

request_export_adapter.scope: Only CPU request preparation, never GPU launch

quality.pure_execution_efficiency_claim: Require identical complete generated token sequences/hashes as well as task-quality completion across each baseline/candidate pair; otherwise label whole-configuration quality-cost comparison, not equal-computation runtime savings
quality.quality_equivalent_but_different_output: Report all outputs and lengths; never discard discrepant pairs or silently switch the primary claim

common_contract.model: Pinned local Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct checkpoint and tokenizer hashes
common_contract.engine: Pinned installed vLLM 0.20.2; full source/config hashes verified before launch
common_contract.length_timeout_cancel_error_or_unknown: Retain as separate incomplete/failure state; never silently replace

phases.purpose: Establish task-level completion and supported quality with the current model
phases.fixed_plan: One pass of six development and six calibration tasks; do not run heldout before R freeze
phases.change_rule: Edits only on development data before freezing later phases

phases.purpose: Incremental MIN observer cost, not candidate energy saving
phases.order: Balanced and preregistered COMMON/MIN versus MIN/COMMON
common_measurement: same closure and pre/post idle windows

phases.each_arm: Fresh worker/engine and declared cold cache state; one pass through identical frozen H
phases.primary_horizon_H: One complete six-task heldout set, including any failures
phases.sample_size_basis: Bounded exploratory fixed-N design, not a power or precision guarantee

candidates.scope_distance_from_W6: Adjacent inference-runtime efficiency; no controlled physical power trajectory or PCC claim
candidates.candidate: enforce_eager=False with one inspected and frozen native resolved compilation/cudagraph/backend configuration
candidates.support_in_docs: Available as a documented option, not proof of installed compatibility
candidates.runtime_treatment_proof: Capture and actual replay evidence on planned task shapes; fallback rates retained
candidates.causal_attribution: Whole resolved runtime configuration if compilation also changes; no graph-only mechanism claim

candidates.scope_distance_from_W6: Changes service contract to multi-request scheduling; not the current single-request estimand

energy.primary: Paired difference in full engine-episode GPU energy for fixed H
energy.cycle: Existing pre 2s + execution/closure/logging + post 2s window; report separately
energy.request_time: From prompt receipt/template start to final output availability, alongside existing engine-visible metrics
energy.postEOS_recovery: Frozen common state/observation rule; include its cost
energy.if_state_not_reset: Limited order-conditioned boundary estimate, no regenerative-cycle closure claim
energy.ratio_total_energy_per_success: Secondary empirical ratio including all failures in numerator; not expected retry-to-success energy
energy.amortization: Only primary H measured; other horizons are labeled model-based sensitivity

statistics.primary_weighting: Fixed design-weighted mean of complete paired-block energy differences; retain scheduled failures and missingness
statistics.unit: Within-device paired block; dependency may persist across blocks on reused GPU
statistics.new_task_generalization: Requires genuinely untouched whole source families; generated family holdout is not external validation
statistics.hardware_generalization: Not supported merely by allocation/session count
statistics.small_cluster_output: Block differences, device counts/reuse, order sensitivity; model intervals only with explicit assumptions
statistics.device_equal_weight_sensitivity: Label as different weighting/estimand, not a repaired primary CI
statistics.incomplete_pairs: Retain missingness/failure; report observed differences with denominator; no overall saving claim when complete-cost contrasts are not identifiable
statistics.claim_without_SLO_MDE: Descriptive effects only, no business noninferiority/SLA conclusion

gates.pass_evidence: Connected authorized existing GPU executor and readable pinned environment
Final pool, validators, split provenance, selected IDs, hashes and order frozen
Endpoint identity/clock/coverage, no foreign compute, complete arm cost ledger and requalified closure
One native graph configuration actually captures/replays; no unplanned confounding config differences
Predeclared finite task quality/completion contract for all scheduled tasks; no outcome-driven exclusions
Approved actual actuator and response, named calibrated electrical boundary, synchronized useful progress, EOS/return and burn costs, state closure, and DC/PCC transfer evidence appropriate to claim

stop_rules: End at the fixed scheduled attempt count, not significance
Stop affected phase on source/model/config drift, corrupt counters, foreign compute or closure/safety failure
Preserve every scheduled attempt and reason; no quality-based replacement
If candidate not supported or no actual treatment, end R with a negative feasibility result
No client sleep/slow-read inferred as GPU actuation
No new resources, installs/upgrades, power settings, burn or external publication without applicable authority

official_sources.supports: enforce_eager controls eager versus permitted hybrid graph execution
Graph dispatch modes, backend compatibility and possible eager fallback
Seed alone is not a cross-configuration reproduction guarantee

phase_namespace: Continuation Q/O/R0/R; distinct from original W6 A-E branches
